message:
You know, when a storm rolls in, it can feel like a showdown between me and the kids. They’re all about the excitement, while I’m just trying to keep my cool and make sure we’re ready. I stumbled upon a handy resource that lays out some smart steps for dealing with tornadoes. It’s like having a game plan—so I can focus on keeping the peace instead of running in circles. 

How do you handle storm prep with your little ones? Any tips to share?
